items.title: Existence of the universal flattening over an Artinian base, given by a closed immersion, hence also a flattening stratification
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the universal flattening for an arbitrary quasi-coherent module on a scheme over the spectrum of an Artinian ring, and notes that it is cut out by a closed immersion of the base, so it is also a flattening stratification (statement lines 6565-6572). The proof reduces to the affine case by the product decomposition of the functor of flat quotients over an affine open covering, and then quotes the affine result over an Artinian base. The reduction and its packaging as a closed condition are the substance, so the claim is H2.
